edges.label: Podesta's 2002 declassification call followed the Disclosure Project's 2001 press conference
edges.note: Podesta appeared for the Coalition for Freedom of Information at the National Press Club on 22 October 2002, seventeen months after Greer's event in the same venue.

edges.label: The initiative worked the Clinton White House while Podesta was Staff Secretary and later Chief of Staff
edges.note: Podesta held senior White House staff positions throughout the initiative's life and has since publicly and repeatedly demanded UFO declassification, including at the National Press Club on 22 October 2002.

edges.label: Greer's CSETI submissions form the majority of the Clinton White House UFO file
edges.note: Clinton FOIA collection 2006-0474-F consists in the majority of documents sent to the White House by Greer - the material reached the building and was filed as correspondence.

edges.label: Greer founded and led the Disclosure Project
edges.note: Greer founded CSETI in 1990 and the Disclosure Project in 1993, culminating in the 9 May 2001 National Press Club event.

edges.label: The Wilson notes place Wilson's 1997 inquiry immediately after exposure to Greer's Washington briefings
edges.note: The Disclosure Project briefed members of Congress and officials in Washington in April 1997; the notes record Wilson beginning his search for the programme in the same period.
